`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire                     clk,
    input  wire                     rst,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         request,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0]         grant,
    output wire                     grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg = 0, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg = 0, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg = 0, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg = 0, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_mask;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] selected_index;
wire request_valid;
wire masked_request_valid;
wire hold_grant;

assign masked_request = request & mask_reg;
assign request_valid = |request;
assign masked_request_valid = |masked_request;
assign hold_grant = ARB_BLOCK &&
    (ARB_BLOCK_ACK ? (grant_valid_reg && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge))) :
                     (|(grant_reg & request)));

// Compute one-hot winners directly, without encoding and then decoding.
generate
    genvar p, b, k;
    for (p = 0; p < PORTS; p = p + 1) begin : winner_bits
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_first
            if (p == 0) begin : first_bit
                assign request_winner[p] = request[p];
                assign masked_winner[p] = masked_request[p];
                assign selected_mask[p] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bits
                assign request_winner[p] = request[p] & ~(|request[p-1:0]);
                assign masked_winner[p] = masked_request[p] & ~(|masked_request[p-1:0]);
                assign selected_mask[p] = |selected_winner[p-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : msb_first
            if (p == PORTS-1) begin : first_bit
                assign request_winner[p] = request[p];
                assign masked_winner[p] = masked_request[p];
                assign selected_mask[p] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bits
                assign request_winner[p] = request[p] & ~(|request[PORTS-1:p+1]);
                assign masked_winner[p] = masked_request[p] & ~(|masked_request[PORTS-1:p+1]);
                assign selected_mask[p] = |selected_winner[PORTS-1:p+1];
            end
        end
    end

    if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin : round_robin_select
        assign selected_winner = masked_winner |
            (request_winner & {PORTS{!masked_request_valid}});
    end else begin : fixed_priority_select
        assign selected_winner = request_winner;
    end

    // The index is an OR encoding of the internally generated one-hot winner.
    for (b = 0; b < $clog2(PORTS); b = b + 1) begin : encode_bits
        wire [PORTS-1:0] terms;
        for (k = 0; k < PORTS; k = k + 1) begin : encode_terms
            if ((k >> b) & 1) begin : included
                assign terms[k] = selected_winner[k];
            end else begin : excluded
                assign terms[k] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign selected_index[b] = |terms;
    end
endgenerate

always @* begin
    grant_next = selected_winner;
    grant_valid_next = request_valid;
    grant_encoded_next = selected_index;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (hold_grant) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && request_valid) begin
        mask_next = selected_mask;
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    grant_reg <= grant_next;
    grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
    grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
    mask_reg <= mask_next;

    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end
end

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference constructs encoded priority results, decodes them into one-hot grants, and computes the next round-robin mask through index arithmetic and variable shifts. This creates potentially deep reconvergent feedback logic. The supplied mapped paths confirm substantial combinational depth and buffering, but do not identify an exact RTL cone.",
  "rewrite": "Replace the two helper instances with top-local parallel priority reductions that directly produce one-hot winners. Select the masked winner when available, otherwise select the unrestricted winner. Compute grant_encoded with OR reductions and compute the next round-robin mask directly from winner prefixes or suffixes, eliminating the encoded-index-to-variable-shift mask computation. Keep blocking and synchronous reset behavior unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended improvement is a shorter mask/grant feedback path by removing encode/decode and arithmetic/shift stages. No candidate synthesis, equivalence check, or STA has been run here, so improvement over the measured baseline WNS of 7.80 ns is not established.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel overlapping reductions can increase wiring, fanout, or duplicated logic, although synthesis may share their terms. Removing the variable-shift mask logic may offset that cost. Mapped area must be checked against the fixed 4880.43072 um2 cap; neither area compliance nor timing improvement is measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the top interface, parameter names/defaults, register initialization values, single positive-edge clock, active-high synchronous reset, and output latency. Arbitrary multi-bit request and acknowledge inputs are handled without one-hot assumptions. The one-hot property used for encoding is produced internally by priority selection. During a blocked grant all output registers and the mask retain their previous values; without requests, outputs clear and the mask holds. Reset remains effective on every edge where rst is high. The frozen helper module is neither modified nor redefined. Formal equivalence against the original frozen RTL under the specified startup contract and parameter overrides remains required."
}
